name: @mentora/adapters-identity-federation
description: The federated-proof adapters of the vestibule (ADR-0004, ratified): generic OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE over the raw protocol - zero provider SDK. Google and Apple are OIDC; GitHub carries its identity sub-adapter. Provider types die HERE (I-7); secrets stay at the vault, addressed by reference (I-8). The entry flow lands with the Account ACL (A05) - the proof-person link lives there.
